title: Kanta-Häme: 2.9 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €115,840 a year
markdown:
# Kanta-Häme: 2.9 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €115,840 a year

> Closes 2.9 of 3.9 missing patients a year (74%) · €115,840 of €1M · €884,160 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kanta-Häme, 32 have no treatment on record a year after diagnosis. In Finland it is 28. That is about 5 patients a year. [^care_no_record] Compared with the best quarter of counties, about 7.6 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 3.4–11.3). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, the gap is 3.9 patients a year (range 0.0–7.6), within the range chance allows. [^care_curative] [^model] Of these, 3.6 fewer are operated and 0.3 fewer are given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 23.4% to 26.0% by 2028: 2.9 more patients a year (range 0.0–3.8), for €115,840 a year, about €40,222 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 74% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (3.9 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €23,840 | 0.9 (0.0–1.4) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.2% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 2 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.3 (0.0–2.4) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 11.7% → 12.9% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.7 (0.0–0.7) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€115,840** | **2.9 (0.0–3.8)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €526,871 a year; modelled to avoid 0.9 deaths a year (0.2–2.3). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 23.4% (2019–2023, measured) → 26.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 11.7% → 12.9% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €884,160 buys nothing more toward treatment that aims to cure. [^model] The measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 85 deaths a year in Kanta-Häme, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.4 of them (range 0.0–1.1). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 55 new patients and 48 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 1 of them (0 to 2) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 23.4% to 25.4% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities. Each range runs from the lowest to the highest value when every assumed effect moves together from its lower to its upper bound. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age. They are not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, smoking or treatment recording, and county figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured. In a check against measured outcomes, 0 of 3 matched in the expected direction beyond chance. [^model]

pilot.text_fi: Kuuden kuukauden pilotti kahdesta toimesta: rintakirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään stereotaktiseen sädehoitoon. Kuudessa kuukaudessa se tarkoittaa noin 55 uutta potilasta ja 48 arvioitua päätöstä. Jos oletuksemme pitävät, noin 1 heistä (0–2) siirtyy sinä aikana parantavaan hoitoon, ja osuus nousee 23,4 %:sta 25,4 %:iin vuoteen 2028 mennessä. Pilotti korvaa oletukset lasketuilla luvuilla.
pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: Kuusi kuukautta on liian lyhyt aika osoittamaan alueen osuuden muutosta. Se riittää laskemaan tehdyt arviot, muuttuneet päätökset ja lähetteet ja vertaamaan niitä samaan jaksoon vuotta aiemmin.
